title: Missing Pebble Mystery

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: Juni, a pebble rolled away while I built my stack

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Let’s ask the meadow gently where it might have gone

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: A polite ask can guide the wind and grass

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Together we’ll listen for a soft sparkle clue

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: The meadow answers with a shimmer, showing the path

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: We follow the glitter, learning asking helps us find things
